explanation: The format string contains two placeholders (%s and %d) but only a single value, `name`, is supplied to the % operator instead of a tuple `(name, age)`. This raises `TypeError: not enough arguments for format string` every time the function is called, since age is never provided.
prompt: Tap the line with the formatting bug.
snippet:
def greet(name, age):
    print("Hello %s, you are %d years old" % name)
